remarks: Welcome to Soundview Towers, where city convenience meets elevated comfort in this beautifully updated 1 bedroom, 1.5 bath fourth-floor residence offering sleek style, generous space, and skyline views from your private balcony. Sunlight fills the open living area through wide windows, creating a warm and inviting flow that extends outdoors to a private balcony perfect for morning coffee or evening unwinding. The updated kitchen features rich wood cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, granite counters, and tile flooring, blending style and practicality with ease. The oversized bedroom offers excellent closet space and natural light, while the beautifully renovated full bath showcases modern tilework, a sleek vanity, and a glass-door tub and shower, complemented by a convenient half bath for guests. Soundview Towers elevates everyday living with a refreshed lobby, fitness center, in-ground pool with sundeck, on-site management, shared storage, and front desk reception, with heat, hot water, snow removal, trash, cooking gas and grounds care included in the HOA. Ideally located with a Walk Score of 87, you're just moments from dining, shopping, parks, bus lines, Metro-North, and the best of Stamford living in this polished, move-in-ready home.
